operation_title: This method retrieves the NF Profile of a given NF instance.

response_body.description: The response body contains the profile of a given NF Instance.

notes: This method shall support the URI query parameters specified in table 6.1.3.3.3.1-1.
No query parameters are defined for this method.
This method shall support the request data structures specified in table 6.1.3.3.3.1-2 and the response data structures and response codes specified in table 6.1.3.3.3.1-3.
No request body data structures are defined for this method.

NOTE: The mandatory HTTP error status codes for the GET method listed in Table 5.2.7.1-1 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4] other than those specified in the table above also apply, with a ProblemDetails data type (see subclause 5.2.7 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4]).

constraints.statement: The request URI shall include the nfInstanceID path variable.
This GET operation shall not include a request body.
This GET operation shall not define any query parameters.
A successful response shall return HTTP 200 OK.
The 200 OK response body shall contain exactly one NFProfile object.
The NFProfile response shall include nfInstanceID.
The NFProfile response shall include nfType.
The NFProfile response shall include nfStatus.
The NFProfile response shall include plmnList with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include sNssais with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include perPlmnSnssaiList with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include nsiList with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include ipv4Addresses with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include ipv6Addresses with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include allowedPlmns with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include allowedNfTypes with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include allowedNfDomains with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include allowedNssais with cardinality at least 1.
The NFProfile response shall include nfServices with cardinality at least 1.
The nfType field shall be one of the NFType enumeration values.
The nfStatus field shall be one of the NFStatus enumeration values.
If present, heartBeatTimer shall be an integer.
If present, priority shall be an integer.
If present, capacity shall be an integer.
If present, load shall be an integer.
If present, nfServicePersistence shall be a boolean.
If present, nfProfileChangesSupportedInd shall be a boolean.
If present, nfProfileChangesInd shall be a boolean.
The NRF shall also apply the mandatory HTTP error status codes for GET defined by 3GPP TS 29.500, with ProblemDetails as the error body.
